property_summary: For every non-empty recipient list, c.transfer must forward a well-formed transferFrom call to the token contract for each recipient, observable as one recorded call per recipient with the correct selector and arguments; the mutant rejects every non-empty list, so no such call is ever recorded and the rule is violated.
change_summary: Replace the require that the input token list is non-empty with a require that it is empty, causing non-empty calls to revert and empty calls to succeed/revert differently.
